thread:
olivia: Quick sync — I pasted the INC-347 postmortem draft below. We need explicit owners + due dates for each action. Please confirm or reassign by EOD PST.

ben: On it. I'll call out owners as I understand them and we can iterate.

ben: Draft owners/dates (first pass)
- infra mitigation: samir — 2026-05-05
- infra permanent fix: samir — 2026-05-10
- runtime patch: marta — 2026-05-04
- telemetry validation: olivia — 2026-05-06
- verification/canary sign-off: oncall-kai — 2026-05-06

marta: I can take runtime but 5/4 is tight — I need until 5/6 because of the release window. If okay I'll own it.

samir: 5/05 for mitigation might be optimistic. I can do an emergency mitigation (rollback + hotfix) by 5/04 and the full remediation by 5/10. Suggest splitting infra tasks into "mitigate" and "remediate". Who owns verification after infra changes?

olivia: good call splitting. verification -> oncall-kai (eng-sre). @oncall-kai can you own canary/validation and sign-off after infra + runtime patches?

oncall-kai: ack. I'll run canaries and smoke tests. Proposed plan: canary runs 2026-05-04, evaluate 5/05, full rollout 5/06 if metrics are green. I'll log results in the canary playbook.

ben: updating owners per convo:
- infra (mitigate): samir — 2026-05-04
- infra (remediate): samir — 2026-05-10
- runtime patch: marta — 2026-05-06
- telemetry validation: olivia — 2026-05-06
- verification/canary: oncall-kai — 2026-05-06

marta: runtime fix depends on research changes to model quant. @jessica-rc can you confirm if research can produce the quant delta for our runtime by 5/05? I only need 4 hours of hands-on testing.

jessica-rc: I can dedicate ~4 hours on 2026-05-05 to validate quant changes and help with testing; I can't own the full change but can unblock marta's testing.

olivia: thanks. ben — please create individual GH issues for each action and assign reviewers. We need PR owners for runtime + infra. Also attach the canary checklist.

ben: will create GH issues and add reviewers. Expect links in this thread by EOD.

infra-bot: ACTION CREATED: GH#4521 infra-mitigate (owner: samir) due 2026-05-04

samir: I started a rollback runbook and will post the mitigation playbook link here shortly.

oncall-kai: quick question — what are the exact smoke metrics for the canary? p95 latency? error-rate threshold? cache-hits?

marta: +1. Suggest p95 latency threshold, error-rate <= 0.1%, and KV cache-hit rate sanity check. If any fail, abort canary.

ben: noted — adding these as checks: p95 latency, error-rate <0.1%, KV cache-hit delta <5%. Will add step to run `kubectl rollout status` + smoke query in the playbook.

olivia: perfect. If anyone can't meet the assigned dates, flag here immediately so we can adjust the rollout. Otherwise I'll mark these owners in the postmortem and move to closure once GH issues are created and owners confirm.

marta: confirmed 5/06 for runtime patch. I’ll add a PR stub and request review from jessica-rc.

ben: GH issues created: GH#4521, GH#4522, GH#4523. Linking PRs in thread when available.

olivia: thanks all — closing the owner-assign step. Follow-ups: samir to post mitigation playbook link; oncall-kai to post canary checklist results after run; marta & jessica-rc to sync on quant test on 5/05.

samir: playbook link posted: https://internal.redwood/infra/playbooks/inc-347-mitigation (uploaded).

oncall-kai: acknowledged — will post canary run results in this thread after 5/04 run.

ben: final note — I've turned these into tracked tasks in the incident board with the dates above. If anything changes we'll update the board + this thread.

olivia: great. If no objections I'll update the postmortem owner table and set a reminder for 5/07 to verify remediation progress.

ben: no objections from me. :thumbsup:

marta: :thumbsup:

olivia: thanks team, closing this owner-confirmation thread.
